environment.description: ECS Fargate service in private subnet (10.0.128.0/20) behind an internal ALB (scheme: internal). The ALB has a listener rule on port 443 with a fixed-response 403 for any source not matching the forward condition. The forward condition uses a header-based routing rule (X-Internal-Routing-Token) validated by an upstream API gateway. The SQS queue resource policy restricts sqs:SendMessage to a condition block requiring aws:SourceVpc matching vpc-0a1b2c3d4e5f (the production VPC) AND aws:PrincipalOrgID matching o-abc123def4. Additionally, the VPC has no internet gateway or NAT gateway path to the SQS endpoint — traffic flows exclusively through a com.amazonaws.us-east-1.sqs VPC endpoint with a policy that restricts sqs:SendMessage to principals within OU ou-root-prodworkloads. The VPC endpoint's security group (sg-0f9e8d7c6b5a4) only permits inbound TCP/443 from CIDR 10.0.0.0/16 (internal corporate range). External actors cannot reach the SQS API endpoint to inject messages.

config.subnet: private, 10.0.128.0/20, no IGW/NAT route to SQS
config.vpc_endpoint: com.amazonaws.us-east-1.sqs with policy restricting SendMessage to OU ou-root-prodworkloads
config.admin_endpoint: removed in this deployment, no HTTP path to enqueue
